faq.q: What is the entry post of the BCS Taxation cadre?
faq.a: Assistant Commissioner of Taxes at the National Board of Revenue, at Grade 9, following BCS entry grades.

faq.q: What is the salary of a BCS Taxation officer?
faq.a: Under the new 9th pay scale the Grade 9 basic is listed at BDT 44,000 (old scale BDT 22,000), paid in stages up to July 2027, plus allowances. Check the gazette for exact figures and for the grade of each rank.

faq.q: What is happening to the NBR?
faq.a: An ordinance in May 2025 abolished the NBR and created Revenue Policy and Revenue Management Divisions. After protests it was amended in September 2025. In April 2026 it faced a deadline to be placed in Parliament, and we could not confirm the final position, so check current news.

faq.q: Where do new tax officers train?
faq.a: At the BCS Tax Academy in Dhaka, the apex training centre for taxation officers. One reported batch finished a six-month basic programme.

faq.q: What is the rank ladder in the tax cadre?
faq.a: Assistant Commissioner, Deputy Commissioner, Joint Commissioner, Additional Commissioner, Commissioner and then Member-level posts at the NBR.

faq.q: How many Taxation posts are advertised?
faq.a: We could not confirm the 50th BCS number, so check the circular. A coaching-centre table for the 45th BCS listed 30, which is only indicative.

faq.q: Do I need an accounting degree for BCS Taxation?
faq.a: It is a general cadre, so any recognised bachelor's degree usually qualifies. Accounting, economics and law help, but check the circular.

faq.q: Does BCS Taxation need a CV?
faq.a: BCS does not choose by CV, and marks decide. A short honest profile helps in the viva and in backup applications. For example: 'Commerce graduate preparing for the BCS general cadre, with experience managing a club budget and filing basic tax records.'

body_md:
**By [Daloyar Hassan Shishir](https://www.dhshishir.com)** · Career consultant, founder of Career Solutions and HereWeGrow · Facts last checked: 19 November 2026 · Last updated: 19 November 2026

> **Quick answer:** BCS (Taxation) is the cadre that collects income tax for Bangladesh. New officers join the National Board of Revenue (NBR) as Assistant Commissioner of Taxes, train at the BCS Tax Academy in Dhaka, and are posted to tax zones, the Large Taxpayer Unit, appeal zones and intelligence units. The cadre uses the same BCS exam as all general cadres (200-mark preliminary, 900-mark written, 100-mark viva). Under the new 9th pay scale the Grade 9 entry basic pay is listed at BDT 44,000, phased in up to July 2027. A big caution for 2026: the NBR itself was split into two divisions by an ordinance in May 2025, and the final structure was still in doubt in April 2026, so check the current set-up before you rank this cadre. We could not confirm the Taxation post count for the 50th BCS.

## Key facts (as of 19 November 2026)

| Question | Answer | Source type |
|---|---|---|
| What is the entry post? | Assistant Commissioner of Taxes | Wikipedia cadre table |
| Who is the employer? | National Board of Revenue (NBR); structure under reform | Daily Star; Prothom Alo |
| Starting basic pay | BDT 44,000 at Grade 9 (new 9th scale, phased in to July 2027); old scale BDT 22,000 | Daily Star Bangla; teacher-portal summary |
| Where do new officers train? | BCS Tax Academy, Dhaka (about six months of basic training in one reported batch) | Academy portal; Financial Express |
| Exam | Preliminary 200 MCQ, written 900, viva 100 | BPSC |
| 50th BCS size | 1,755 cadre posts; 290,951 applicants; Taxation count not confirmed | bdnews24; Dhaka Times |
| NBR split | Ordinance issued 12 May 2025, amended 1 Sept 2025; faced a 10 April 2026 deadline in Parliament | Prothom Alo; Daily Star |
| Rank ladder at NBR | Assistant, Deputy, Joint and Additional Commissioner, Commissioner, Member | NBR transfer-posting pages |

*Numbers can change with each circular. The BPSC circular and the gazette are the final authority.*

## What does a BCS Taxation officer do?

A Taxation officer works on direct tax: assessing returns, running audits, hearing appeals, investigating evasion and helping people and companies comply. NBR transfer and promotion notices show where officers are posted:

- **Tax zones** (field offices that handle taxpayers by area) and the **Large Taxpayer Unit**.
- **Tax appellate zones**, where disputes are heard.
- **Income Tax Intelligence and Investigation** and the **E-Tax Management Unit**.
- **NBR headquarters**, including First and Second Secretary (Tax) posts and a transfer pricing team.

The NBR has two groups of officers on the income-tax side. BCS (Tax) cadre officers are recruited directly through BPSC. Departmental officers, such as tax inspectors and extra assistant commissioners, rise from inside the department. UNB reported that after a gap of 33 years non-cadre officers were promoted to Deputy Commissioner, with their association describing long stagnation caused by the lack of an integrated gradation system. Expect this to be a live issue in your career.

## What is the NBR reform, and why does it matter to you?

This is the biggest uncertainty for the cadre, so read it carefully.

- **12 May 2025:** the interim government issued the Revenue Policy and Revenue Management Ordinance, 2025, which abolished the NBR and created a Revenue Policy Division and a Revenue Management Division under the Finance Ministry. <cite index="240-1">The policy division would draft tax laws, set rates and oversee tax treaties, while the management division would handle enforcement, audits and compliance for income tax, VAT and customs.</cite>
- **Protests:** tax and customs cadre officers protested for weeks, arguing the ordinance would hand top posts to administration cadre officers. Some officers were later punished under discipline rules, according to UNB.
- **1 September 2025:** an amendment said the head of the Revenue Management Division must come from officials with revenue-collection experience, while the Policy Division head could be someone with experience in macroeconomics, trade policy or planning (TBS).
- **April 2026:** Prothom Alo reported on 6 April 2026 that the new government had not yet put the ordinance before Parliament and that it would lapse if not presented by 10 April 2026. The Financial Express described the split as looking uncertain.
- **Later in 2026:** NBR notices continue to list transfers and postings of tax officers, and some reports in mid-2026 describe the two divisions in present terms. We could not confirm which structure is legally in force today.

**What to do:** check the latest news and BPSC circular before you choose this cadre. Whatever structure survives, income tax collection will continue to need officers.

## What is the career ladder?

| Rank | Notes |
|---|---|
| Assistant Commissioner of Taxes | Entry post for BCS (Tax) at Grade 9 |
| Deputy Commissioner of Taxes | Promotion from Assistant Commissioner |
| Joint Commissioner of Taxes | |
| Additional Commissioner of Taxes | |
| Commissioner of Taxes | Often heads a tax zone or a major unit |
| Member (Income Tax) and above | Senior NBR posts |

*The rank names come from NBR's transfer-posting pages and news reports on promotions. We have not verified the pay grade attached to each rank, so check the gazette for grades.*

**Promotion facts to know:**

- Reports show regular batches of promotions, for example officers moving from Joint Commissioner to Additional Commissioner and into posts at tax zones, the Large Taxpayer Unit and the intelligence unit.
- Promotion timelines depend on vacancies, the batch and the service rules, so avoid counting on a fixed number of years.

## How many Taxation posts are there, and how hard is it?

We could not find the Taxation post count for the 50th BCS in the sources we checked. A coaching-centre table for the 45th BCS lists 30 Taxation posts, which is only indicative. NBR's own notices show the 44th BCS (Tax) officers received postings in February 2026, which tells you the timeline from exam to posting can run for years.

| Exam | Total cadre posts | Applicants |
|---|---|---|
| 47th BCS | 3,487 advertised; 1,320 recommended | 374,747 |
| 50th BCS | 1,755 | 290,951 |

In the 50th BCS, 12,385 passed the preliminary and 6,165 passed the written exam (result published 23 July 2026). Allocation depends on your merit position, your cadre choices and the vacancies.

## What happens in training?

- **BCS Tax Academy, Dhaka.** It describes itself as the apex training centre for taxation officers and exists mainly to train entrant officers of the cadre. The Financial Express reported a six-month basic training programme concluding for 40 assistant tax commissioners of the 34th and 36th batches.
- **BPATC.** New civil servants also complete foundation training under the training policy within two years of joining.
- **Advanced training.** The NBR has run EU-funded advanced audit courses for income tax officials, and IMF-linked courses exist for NBR officers.

## What is the salary and what are the benefits?

The 9th National Pay Scale was approved by cabinet on 31 August 2026 and takes effect from 1 July 2026. Basic pay is raised in stages up to July 2027, so early pay is below the final figure. Allowances are reset from January 2028.

| Grade | Old basic (BDT) | New basic (BDT) |
|---|---|---|
| 9 (Assistant Commissioner entry) | 22,000 | 44,000 |
| 6 | 35,500 | 71,000 |
| 5 | 43,000 | 86,000 |
| 3 | 56,500 | 1,13,000 |
| 2 | 66,000 | 1,32,000 |
| 1 | 78,000 | 1,56,000 |

*Source note: these figures come from a teacher-portal summary of the new scale, not the gazette. The Daily Star Bangla separately confirms Grade 1 at BDT 1,56,000. We have not matched each tax rank to a grade, so check the gazette.*

**Benefits beyond basic pay** (check your appointment terms): house rent and medical allowance, festival bonuses, leave and pension under government rules, and training opportunities. Revenue work also carries pressure to meet collection targets. In a bdnews24 interview, the NBR chairman said the board had faced immense pressure to meet revenue targets.

## Which skills does a tax officer need?

| Skill | Why it matters | Demand |
|---|---|---|
| Income tax law and procedure | Core of assessment and appeals | █████ |
| Accounting and financial statements | Reading company accounts and returns | █████ |
| Audit and investigation | Finding under-reporting and evasion | ████ |
| Integrity and resisting pressure | Large sums and powerful taxpayers | █████ |
| Digital tools and data analysis | E-filing, risk analysis, e-tax systems | ████ |
| Official writing | Assessment orders and appeal responses | ███ |
| Communication with taxpayers | Hearings and compliance help | ███ |
| Economics and policy understanding | Understanding revenue and rate effects | ███ |

*Bars show our reading of the role, not a survey.*

## How do I get in? The exam path

Taxation uses the general BCS exam: a 200-mark MCQ preliminary, a 900-mark written exam (Bangla 200, English 200, Bangladesh Affairs 200, International Affairs 100, Mathematical Reasoning and Mental Ability 100, General Science and Technology 100) and a 100-mark viva. See our BCS overview for the full guide.

**To aim for Taxation:**

1. Put Taxation on your cadre list only if the work interests you, and add realistic second and third choices.
2. Build maths and reasoning early; numbers matter in this cadre and in the exam.
3. Learn basic accounting and the idea of income tax: who pays, how returns work, what an appeal is.
4. Read the NBR reform story so you can discuss it calmly in the viva.
5. Practise written answers on economy and governance.
6. Keep a plan B.

## Where will you find more peace of mind?

No cadre is free of pressure, and we have no survey to rank them. Tax work brings collection targets, taxpayer pressure and, in 2025, a very public dispute over the agency's structure. Three habits protect your peace: keep every decision documented, stay clear of anything that looks like a favour, and keep colleagues you can talk to honestly.

## Plan your own path (5-minute worksheet)

Copy these lines and fill them in today:

1. **My age on the next cut-off date:** ___ (must be 32 or under)
2. **My cadre choices:** 1) Taxation 2) ___ 3) ___
3. **My comfort with numbers (score out of 10):** ___
4. **Three weakest subjects:** ___, ___, ___
5. **Daily practice minutes (writing and maths):** ___ (aim for 90)
6. **My plan B if I do not get a cadre:** ___

Then take the free skill test on this page and compare the result with line 4.

## Faith and history: honest measure

**The Quran.** Surah Ar-Rahman 55:9 says to establish weight with justice and not to fall short in the balance ([read it on quran.com](https://quran.com/55/9)). A tax officer's work is a form of measuring, and this verse sets the standard.

**Hadith.** The Prophet (peace be upon him) said that whoever is appointed to a task and given a salary, anything he takes beyond that is misappropriation (Sunan Abi Dawud 2943). It is a sharp reminder to refuse anything beyond lawful pay.

**History.** The NBR was established in 1972 to mobilise revenue for the newly independent country, according to The Daily Star. Whatever its future structure, collecting tax fairly remains central to the state.

## Your contribution to the nation

Taxes pay for schools, hospitals, roads and relief. A fair assessment that treats an honest small taxpayer kindly and an evader firmly builds trust in the system. Better compliance can reduce the pressure on ordinary families and strengthen the government's ability to serve them.

## Your contribution to the world

Tax officers learn audit, transfer pricing and data skills that international bodies value. Many go on to study public finance abroad and to work with development agencies or on international tax cooperation.

## If you do not get BCS Taxation

- **Other BCS cadres.** The same exam leads to Administration, Police, Customs and Excise, Audit and Accounts and more. Customs and Excise sits in the same revenue family.
- **Departmental route.** The NBR has tax inspector posts and promotion routes inside the department. Check current circulars.
- **Professional careers.** Chartered accountancy (CA, CMA) and tax practice are common and rewarding paths.
- **Private sector and development jobs** in finance, audit and compliance.

## Research opportunities

- Topics with real need: tax compliance and trust, digital tax administration, the effects of separating policy from collection, transfer pricing and taxpayer services.
- Where to learn: accounting, finance and economics departments, tax think tanks and the BCS Tax Academy.
- Path: a strong master's thesis, a research assistant post, then MPhil or PhD.

## Whom to follow and learn from

Follow institutions: [BPSC](https://www.bpsc.gov.bd), the [National Board of Revenue](https://nbr.gov.bd) and the [BCS Tax Academy](https://bcstaxacademy.portal.gov.bd). Treat coaching centre promises and social media rank claims with caution.

## Where do I find circulars?

- BPSC's official site: [bpsc.gov.bd](https://www.bpsc.gov.bd).
- Teletalk's BPSC application portal: bpsc.teletalk.com.bd.
- Daily newspapers' job pages (cross-check every date and number with the circular).

**No lobbying.** Tadbir during the application process is treated as grounds for disqualification.

## How should I write my profile and CV?

BCS does not choose candidates from a CV. Marks decide. A short, honest profile helps in the viva and in backup applications.

| Weak line | Better line |
|---|---|
| Good with numbers. | Scored 85% in accounting and prepared a 12-page tax comparison for a student project. |
| Honest and responsible. | Managed a BDT 2 lakh club budget and published a full account to all members. |
| Interested in tax. | Completed a free online taxation course and helped 15 neighbours understand return filing basics. |

*Use only real, provable figures.*

Build yours free with the HereWeGrow CV Builder.

## What are the common mistakes?

- Choosing Taxation without checking the current NBR structure.
- Ignoring maths and basic accounting.
- Skipping written practice.
- Treating the viva as a place for memorised answers.
- Having no plan B.
- Believing rumours about marks or posts instead of the circular.

## Changelog

- **19 Nov 2026:** First version. Taxation post count for the 50th BCS not found; NBR structure after April 2026 not confirmed. Both flagged in the text.
- Next planned review: when the 52nd BCS circular is published or the NBR structure is settled.

growth_plan.y1: Download the latest circular and syllabus, build maths and basic accounting, follow the NBR story, fix your weakest two subjects and apply when the circular opens.

cv_template_notes: BCS does not select by CV, so use a clean one-page academic-style HWG layout (single column, no heavy graphics) for your viva profile, backup applications and scholarships. Lead with education and results, then accounting or tax coursework, internships, volunteering and any research. Add real numbers (budgets managed, hours served, scores). Keep it to one page. File name: YourName_BCS_Taxation_Aspirant_CV.pdf. Use only facts you can prove in a viva.
cover_letter_md:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the [position] advertised on [site/date]. I hold a [degree] from [university] and have strong accounting, analytical and writing skills built while preparing for the BCS Taxation cadre. In [project/volunteering role] I [one provable result, e.g. managed a BDT 2 lakh club budget and published a full account to all members].

My CV is attached as a PDF. I would be glad to attend an interview.

Sincerely,
[Your name] | [Phone] | [Email]

(Note: BCS itself needs no cover letter. Use this for backup non-BCS applications.)
interview_qs: Why do you want to join the Taxation cadre? (Tip: Give a real reason from experience; talk about public finance and fairness, not status.)
What does an Assistant Commissioner of Taxes do? (Tip: Mention assessing returns, audits, hearings and taxpayer service.)
Why do people pay tax, and why do some avoid it? (Tip: Balanced answer: public services, trust, complexity and enforcement.)
What is your view on the NBR split into policy and management divisions? (Tip: Show you know both sides: reform goals and officers' concerns; stay calm and neutral.)
What would you do if a powerful businessman pressured you to reduce his tax? (Tip: Follow the law, document, inform your superior, stay polite.)
What is the difference between tax avoidance and tax evasion? (Tip: Avoidance uses legal gaps; evasion breaks the law; give one example each.)
What is a progressive tax? (Tip: Higher incomes pay higher rates; mention fairness and revenue.)
How can digital systems improve tax collection? (Tip: E-filing, risk-based audits, data matching; mention privacy and fairness.)
Tell us about your district and its small taxpayers. (Tip: Two facts, two problems, one realistic idea for compliance.)
How would you treat a small shopkeeper who does not understand the rules? (Tip: Explain clearly and help first; enforce only when needed.)
Why not Customs or another cadre? (Tip: Show you know the other cadre; explain your fit with Taxation.)
How do you handle revenue-target pressure? (Tip: Stay lawful; focus on compliance and honest assessment, not shortcuts.)
Describe a time you handled money or records honestly. (Tip: Situation, action, result in numbers if possible.)
What will you do if you are not selected this time? (Tip: Show a calm plan B; do not sound defeated.)
Do you have any questions for us? (Tip: Ask about training or learning, not about pay or posting.)
